subject: Biology
title: Excretory Products and Their Elimination
summary: Animals nitrogenous waste ammonia (ammonotelic — sabse toxic, bahut paani chahiye), urea (ureotelic) ya uric acid (uricotelic — sabse kam toxic, thoda paani) ki tarah nikaalte hain.
Insaan mein ek jodi kidney hai, har ek mein lagbhag das lakh nephron. Nephron mein glomerulus aur Bowman's capsule (Malpighian body) aur tubule: PCT, loop of Henle, DCT, collecting duct.
Urine glomerular filtration, tubular reabsorption aur secretion se banta hai. Counter-current mechanism (loop of Henle + vasa recta) urine ko concentrate karta hai.
Kidney ka kaam ADH, renin–angiotensin–aldosterone system aur ANF (atrial natriuretic factor) control karte hain. Lungs, liver aur skin bhi excretion mein madad karte hain.

formulas.name: Modes of excretion
formulas.formula: ammonotelic: bony fish, aquatic amphibians, aquatic insects;  ureotelic: mammals, many terrestrial amphibians, marine fish;  uricotelic: reptiles, birds, land snails, insects
formulas.when: Animals ko waste type se milaana.

formulas.name: Excretory structures
formulas.formula: protonephridia/flame cells (Platyhelminthes, Amphioxus);  nephridia (annelids);  Malpighian tubules (insects);  antennal/green glands (prawns);  kidneys (vertebrates)

formulas.name: Glomerular filtration rate
formulas.formula: GFR ≈ 125 mL/min ≈ 180 L/day;  urine ≈ 1–1.5 L/day → ~99% of filtrate is reabsorbed

formulas.name: Filtration membrane
formulas.formula: endothelium of glomerular blood vessels + basement membrane + epithelium of Bowman's capsule (podocytes with filtration slits)
formulas.when: Ultrafiltration — proteins aur cells ke alawa sab guzarta hai.

formulas.name: Tubule functions
formulas.formula: PCT: reabsorbs 70–80% of electrolytes and water, all glucose and amino acids; reabsorbs HCO₃⁻; secretes H⁺, NH₃, K⁺ (pH and ionic balance);  descending limb: permeable to water, not electrolytes;  ascending limb: impermeable to water, transports electrolytes;  DCT: conditional reabsorption of Na⁺ (NaCl) and water, HCO₃⁻ reabsorption; secretes H⁺, K⁺, NH₃ (pH and Na⁺–K⁺ balance);  collecting duct: large water reabsorption, allows some urea to pass into the medulla

formulas.name: Counter-current mechanism
formulas.formula: opposite flow in limbs of Henle's loop and vasa recta → medullary osmolarity rises from 300 to about 1200 mOsmolL⁻¹ (NaCl + urea)
formulas.note: Human urine filtrate se lagbhag chaar guna zyada concentrated ho sakta hai.

formulas.name: ADH (vasopressin)
formulas.formula: released from neurohypophysis when body fluid volume falls → more water reabsorbed from DCT and collecting duct;  deficiency → diabetes insipidus

formulas.name: RAAS
formulas.formula: low GFR/BP → JGA releases renin → angiotensinogen → angiotensin I → (ACE) angiotensin II (vasoconstrictor) → aldosterone from adrenal cortex → Na⁺ and water reabsorption → BP and GFR rise

formulas.name: ANF (atrial natriuretic factor)
formulas.formula: released when blood pressure/volume rises → vasodilation → lowers BP;  acts as a check on RAAS

formulas.name: Micturition
formulas.formula: urinary bladder stretches → stretch receptors → CNS → contraction of bladder smooth muscle and relaxation of urethral sphincter (micturition reflex)

formulas.name: Abnormal urine tests
formulas.formula: glycosuria (glucose) and ketonuria (ketone bodies) indicate diabetes mellitus

formulas.name: Disorders
formulas.formula: uremia (urea builds up — treated by haemodialysis);  renal calculi (kidney stones — crystallised salts, oxalates);  glomerulonephritis (inflammation of glomeruli)

examples.title: Ek din ka filtrate
examples.problem: GFR 125 mL/min hai. Ek din mein kitna filtrate banta hai?

examples.title: Kitna percentage reabsorb
examples.problem: 180 L filtrate se 1.5 L urine bane to kitna percentage reabsorb hua?

examples.title: Birds aur uric acid
examples.problem: Birds uric acid kyun nikaalte hain?
examples.solution: Uric acid sabse kam toxic hai aur bahut kam paani ke saath paste ki tarah nikal sakta hai, paani aur vazan bachta hai — udne wale animals aur shell wale ande ke andar embryos ke liye faaydemand.

examples.title: Diabetes insipidus
examples.problem: Ek vyakti bahut zyada patla urine nikaalta hai jisme glucose nahi. Sambhavit kaaran?
examples.solution: ADH ki kami (diabetes insipidus): ADH ke bina DCT aur collecting ducts se paani reabsorb nahi hota.

examples.title: Juxta medullary nephrons
examples.problem: Kin nephrons mein lamba loop of Henle hota hai, aur ye kyun zaroori hai?
examples.solution: Juxta medullary nephrons — inke lambe loops medulla mein gehre jaate hain aur vasa recta ke saath concentrated urine ke liye medullary gradient banate hain. Cortical nephrons ke loops chhote.

examples.title: Haemodialysis
examples.problem: Artificial kidney kaise kaam karti hai?
examples.solution: Artery ka blood thanda karke heparin (anticoagulant) milate hain aur dialyser ki cellophane tubes se guzaarte hain jo plasma jaise par bina nitrogenous waste wale dialysing fluid mein hain; waste bahar diffuse hota hai aur saaf blood anti-heparin milakar vein se waapas jaata hai.

topics.title: Human excretory system
topics.explain: Do kidneys, do ureters, ek urinary bladder aur ek urethra. Kidneys laal-bhoori, sem ke beej jaisi, lagbhag 10–12 cm lambi, 5–7 cm chaudi, 2–3 cm moti, 120–170 g; hilum par ureter, blood vessels aur nerves andar-bahar jaate hain. Bahar cortex, andar medulla medullary pyramids ke saath; renal columns (columns of Bertini) cortex ke extensions hain.

topics.title: Nephron structure
topics.explain: Glomerulus: afferent arteriole se bana capillaries ka guchha, efferent arteriole se drain hota hai. Efferent arteriole peritubular capillaries banata hai; Henle's loop ke saath chalne wali patli vessel vasa recta hai (cortical nephrons mein kam ya nahi).

topics.title: Juxta glomerular apparatus (JGA)
topics.explain: DCT aur afferent arteriole ke milne ki jagah cells ke badlaav se bana khaas sensitive region. GFR girne ko mehsoos karke renin chhodta hai.

topics.title: Role of other organs
topics.explain: Lungs har minute lagbhag 200 mL CO₂ aur paani nikaalte hain. Liver bile mein bilirubin, biliverdin, cholesterol, toote steroid hormones, vitamins aur drugs nikaalta hai. Skin: sweat glands NaCl, thoda urea aur lactic acid nikaalte hain (mainly thandak ke liye); sebaceous glands sterols, hydrocarbons aur waxes.

topics.title: Kidney transplantation
topics.explain: Acute renal failure ka aakhri ilaaj; donor (behtar ho kareebi rishtedaar) se kaam karti kidney li jaati hai taaki immune system rejection kam ho. Dialysis tab tak sahara deta hai.

topics.title: Urine characteristics
topics.explain: Halka peela, paani jaisa, thoda acidic (pH 6.0); roz average 25–30 g urea nikalta hai.

ratta: Ammonia: bony fish;  urea: mammals;  uric acid: birds, reptiles, insects.
PCT: all glucose & amino acids;  ascending limb impermeable to water.
ADH ↑ water reabsorption; lack → diabetes insipidus.
PCT and DCT both: reabsorb NaCl, H₂O, HCO₃⁻;  secrete H⁺, K⁺, NH₃.
